briefing.headline: Stagflation territory, driven by rising CPI.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Headline CPI was 3.4 percent for Jun 2026.
Core CPI registered 3.1 percent for May 2026.

briefing.whats_new: Today: CPI hotter, from 2.9 percent to 3.4 percent.
briefing.regime_change: The call moved from Soft landing to Stagflation territory as CPI climbed while Core CPI held firm.
